d:
A man who sold suitcases for 30 years told Mokobara’s founders they might earn ₹15 crore in their lifetime. Last financial year, Mokobara did ₹230 crore in revenue.
In this video, Rahul breaks down how two founders walked into one of the most boring, crowded categories in India and built a brand that sold itself. You will see the market numbers, the 33 investor rejections, the pandemic pivot, the Diljit Dosanjh moment, the IndiGo deal, and the one layer of the business they still do not control.
